name: io.github.suyash1603/nomad-mcp-server
description: Safe, structured access to a HashiCorp Nomad cluster: jobs, allocations, task logs, nodes, node pools, deployments, quotas and scheduler evaluations, plus cross-cutting investigation tools that scan for problems, search a job's logs and reconstruct its timeline. Works with Community Edition and Enterprise. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_ADDR
environmentVariables.description: Address of the Nomad HTTP API, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4646

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Nomad ACL token. Use a read-only policy scoped to the namespaces you want visible, not a management token.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: Default Nomad namespace for namespaced tools

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Refuse every tool that would change the cluster. Leave this true unless you specifically want the assistant to be able to stop jobs and drain nodes.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_MCP_ALLOWED_NAMESPACES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of namespaces the server may touch. Unset means all of them.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_MCP_ALLOW_VARIABLE_READS
environmentVariables.description: Allow read_variable to return Nomad Variable values. Variables are the cluster's secret store; this is separate from read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to offer: system, jobs, allocs, investigate, capacity, nodes, deployments, catalog, variables, diag, enterprise, acl. Narrowing this cuts the context the catalog costs on every request and limits what the server can reach at all. The acl toolset additionally needs NOMAD_MCP_ENABLE_ACL.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_MCP_ENABLE_ACL
environmentVariables.description: Offer the ACL tools: policies, tokens and roles. Off by default and not selected by NOMAD_MCP_TOOLSETS=all, because these govern who may use the cluster at all. No tool mints a management token or deletes anything.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_MCP_ALLOW_TOKEN_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Allow the ACL tools to return a token's secret. Off by default; the accessor ID is returned instead, and the operator retrieves the secret with 'nomad acl token info'. Separate from read-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_ADDR
environmentVariables.description: Address of the Nomad HTTP API

environmentVariables.name: NOMAD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Nomad ACL token. Prefer a read-only policy.
